current_superior_order.follow_on_requirement: Execute this contact-development mission within current campaign authority. Exact march sequence, formation use, reconnaissance depth, and local self-defense remain Tang Wei's decisions. Deliberate general battle commitment is not contained in this order; report confirmed contact or another material change to superior command.

mission_packet.agency_rule: Superior command sets mission and reporting scope only. Tang Wei retains exact route, formation assignment, reconnaissance depth, reserve posture, battle commitment, and tactics unless a later exact lawful order states otherwise.
mission_packet.next_phase_trigger: Confirmed enemy contact or another material operational change is reported to field command. Contact itself does not authorize or automatically start a general battle.
mission_packet.success_condition: Locate, confirm, observe, and report enemy dispositions affecting the Sanyou axis while maintaining Sanyou as the field-command anchor and preserving campaign support continuity.
mission_packet.support_continuity_rule: This field command remains a supported component of the wider campaign unless an exact later order detaches it. Developing contact does not make the parent army disappear and does not itself authorize a general attack.

current_superior_order.objective: Locate, confirm, observe, and report the enemy formations affecting the Sanyou axis while maintaining Sanyou as the field-command anchor. Develop tactical contact without treating contact itself as a general-attack order; preserve campaign coordination and report material changes.

echelon.comparison_rule: Campaign comparisons use peer primary commands/field bodies. Tactical leaf formations remain subordinate mechanics and are not peer army counts.

information.claim: Qin Military Bureau briefing. Tang Wei's field command numbers 9,500 troops organized under 3 primary command(s), currently at Sanyou. Of these, 5,000 are Qin-assigned troops and 4,500 are House or retinue troops accompanying under Tang Wei's own authority. Other Qin forces on the campaign roster: 73,200 troops organized under 3 primary command(s), under Kanki, Mou Gou, Ousen, at Sanyou, task: concentrate Mou Gou, Ousen, and Kanki field forces for the northern Wei campaign; 46,100 troops organized under 2 primary command(s), under Ouki, Tou, at Keiyou, task: concentrate Ouki and Tou field forces for the northern Wei campaign; 40,000 troops organized under 1 primary command(s), under Mou Bu, at Qin Southern March, task: hold Mou Bu's shock army ready for the northern Wei campaign; 5,000 troops represented by 1 aggregate field body/bodies, under Fan Yi, at Sanyou, task: maintain the Qin mobile reserve as a participant in the northern Wei campaign; 3,000 troops represented by 1 aggregate field body/bodies, under Shou Hei Kun, at Qin Eastern Military Depot, task: maintain the eastern reserve as a participant in the northern Wei campaign. Combined Qin strength on the current campaign roster is 176,800. The staff designate Sanyou as the present operational area. Qin has authorized movement into the target state; the field command may now advance toward Sanyou. Intelligence estimate: an official estimate of roughly 88,000-145,000 troops able to influence the theater; 6 distinct opposing field body/bodies reported; opposing commanders: Gai Mou, Huan Zhen, Deng Shan, Go Hou Mei, Jing Rong, Rei Ou; no confirmed battle contact. These are staff estimates. A reported enemy field body is not assumed to have the same internal echelon structure as one of Tang Wei's tactical leaf formations. The Bureau's written orders direct the field command to concentrate and report at Sanyou, then march toward Sanyou when Tang Wei gives the order.

information.claim: Field-command arrival report: Tang Wei's field army has reached Sanyou and completed the current concentration/advance phase. March security placed the army's assigned forward-security element on forward security/reconnaissance. Current staff intelligence remains roughly 88,000-145,000 troops able to influence the theater; no confirmed battle contact. The army has not been committed to a battle or further advance by this report. The command remains ready for a follow-on order, confirmed enemy contact, or Tang Wei's own lawful reconnaissance and maneuver decisions.
